import hashlib,json,os,shutil,statistics,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd();folder=root/'.cache/native-simd';original=root/'.cache/simd-survey'
policy=json.loads((folder/'policy.json').read_text())
report={'policy':policy,'results':[]}
for case in policy['cases']:
 reference=(original/case/'answer.txt').read_bytes()
 rows={'original':[],'simd':[]}
 for trial in range(policy['process_trials']):
  for variant in (['original','simd'] if trial%2==0 else ['simd','original']):
   work=folder/'complete'/case/str(trial)/variant;work.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
   shutil.copyfile(original/case/'input.txt',work/'input.txt')
   base=original if variant=='original' else folder
   if case.startswith('gf-'):
    p={'gf-p3-d500':3,'gf-p65521-d500':65521,'gf-p61-d500':2305843009213693951}[case]
    cmd=[str(base/'dense-factor'),'dense','input.txt','answer.txt','result.json',str(p),'comparable',str(policy['complete_min_seconds']),str(policy['complete_min_repetitions']),'1']
   else:
    cmd=[str(base/'groebner-gf5'),'input.txt','answer.txt','result.json','lex','comparable','65521',str(policy['complete_min_seconds']),str(policy['complete_min_repetitions'])]
   with (work/'stdout').open('w') as out,(work/'stderr').open('w') as err:
    subprocess.run(cmd,cwd=work,stdout=out,stderr=err,check=True,timeout=60,preexec_fn=lambda:os.sched_setaffinity(0,{0}))
   answer=(work/'answer.txt').read_bytes();assert answer==reference,(case,trial,variant)
   result=json.loads((work/'result.json').read_text())
   assert len(result['times_ns'])>=policy['complete_min_repetitions'],(case,variant,'first call exceeded repeat threshold')
   rows[variant].append({'trial':trial,'command':cmd,'result':result,'median_ns':statistics.median(result['times_ns']),'answers_match':True,'answer_sha256':hashlib.sha256(answer).hexdigest()})
 med={v:statistics.median(r['median_ns'] for r in rows[v]) for v in rows}
 vals=[r['median_ns'] for r in rows['original']]
 threshold=max(0.05,2*(max(vals)-min(vals))/med['original'])
 item={'case':case,'processes':rows,'median_ns':med,'speedup':med['original']/med['simd'],'change':med['simd']/med['original']-1,'regression_screen':threshold}
 report['results'].append(item)
 (folder/'complete.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
 print(case,'original',round(med['original']/1e6,3),'ms simd',round(med['simd']/1e6,3),'ms ratio',round(item['speedup'],3),'change',round(100*item['change'],2),'%',flush=True)
print('ALL ANSWERS MATCH',flush=True)

from pathlib import Path
import collections,json,re,subprocess
folder=Path('.cache/native-simd');report=[]
for name in ['dense-factor','groebner-gf5','micro']:
 p=folder/name
 if not p.exists():continue
 for line in subprocess.check_output(['nm','-S','-n','-C','--defined-only',str(p)],text=True).splitlines():
  bits=line.split(maxsplit=3)
  if len(bits)!=4 or bits[2].lower() not in ['t','w']:continue
  sym=bits[3]
  if not any(s in sym for s in ['_nmod::_dot[','_nmod::_Spectral::forward','_nmod::_Spectral::back','_fglm::_Forms::multiply','_ntt::_word_stage_width','_ntt::_forward[','_ntt::_inverse[']):continue
  start=int(bits[0],16);size=int(bits[1],16)
  asm=subprocess.check_output(['objdump','-d','--no-show-raw-insn',f'--start-address={start}',f'--stop-address={start+size}',str(p)],text=True)
  opcodes=collections.Counter()
  for row in asm.splitlines():
   m=re.match(r'\s*[0-9a-f]+:\s+(\S+)',row)
   if m:opcodes[m[1]]+=1
  report.append({'binary':name,'symbol':sym,'start':start,'size':size,'instructions':dict(opcodes),'zmm_operands':len(re.findall(r'%zmm',asm))})
  print(name,sym.split('(')[0][:80],size,'vpmuludq',opcodes['vpmuludq'],'zmm',report[-1]['zmm_operands'])
  (folder/f'assembly-{name}-{start:x}.txt').write_text(asm)
(folder/'assembly.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
